[bhamu+ta．bhamuanavatthāne，bhamittāti bhanto．nirutti，nhā．488．rū．nhā．378．]

bhante.cp: voc. of bhadanta. Reverend Sir; O lord.

C: bhante：[voc．of bhadanta] Reverend Sir; O lord．
P: Bhante，[would correspond either to Sk．*bhavantaḥ （with ending °e as Māgadhism for °aḥ）=bhavān，or to P．bhadanta．In both cases we have a contraction．The expl<sup>n</sup> bhante=bhadante （bhadantaḥ） is advocated by Pischel，Prk．Gr．§§ 165，366<sup>b</sup>，intimated also by Weber，Bhagavatī 156 n．3 （unable to explain --e）; the expl<sup>n</sup> bhante=bhavantah （see bhavaṁ） by Geiger，P．Gr．98<sup>3</sup>; hinted at by Weber Loc．cit．（bhavantaḥ=bhagavantaḥ）] Voc．of polite address：Sir，venerable Sir，used like bhadante．Either abs．as Voc．：Vin．I，76; D．II，154，283; J．II，111; III，46; Miln．19; or with another Voc．：Miln．25; or with other oblique cases，as with Nom．D．I，179; DhA．I，62．with Gen．D．I，179．（Page 498）
I: bhante：This is a contracted form of bhadante．It is used as a reverential term of address，＂Lord＂，＂Reverend sir＂，and is the proper address of Buddha，of Buddhist priests，of ṛishis，tāpasas，etc．
R:
bhante：ဘနေ္တ （အာလုပ်）
အရှင်ဘုရား။
ဘနေ္တ ဘဂဝါ၊ ဘုန်းတော်ကြီးသော အရှင်ဘုရား။
DOP: bhante voc. [ AMg id. ] ( cf Sadd 679, 1 : garūnaṃ matantare bhavantasaddassa sabbass’ eva bhonta ~e bhonto bhadde icc ete ādesā honti ge pare gassa ca lopo hoti; 679, 5 : ~e bhadde ti ekaputhuvacanantam avyayaṃ … so te bhikkhū khamāpesi khamatha ~e ti), a term of polite address to a respected or revered person (or persons): sir, venerable sir(s); S V 176, 24 (evaṃ ~e ti kho so puriso Sirivaḍḍhassa gahapatino paṭissutvā); 390, 20 (aññataro puriso Nandakaṃ Licchaviṃ mahāmattaṃ etad avoca nahānakālo ~e ti); 447, 10 foll. (so bhikkhave puriso … mahājanakāyassa ārocesi ummatto ’smi nāmāhaṃ ~e viceto smi nāmāhaṃ ~e); Ja III 4, 20 (bodhisattaṃ upasaṅkamitvā … ~e Kaliṅgo ca Assako ca yujjhitukāmā … kassa parājayo bhavissatī ti pucchi); 65, 10* (kā su ~e gatī mamaṃ); 110, 23 (rājā … bodhisattaṃ pucchi kiṃ nu kho ~e idaṃ nigrodhapakkaṃ ativiya madhuran ti); — esp. addressed to the Buddha and members of the Buddhist saṅgha; Vin I 76, 32 (bhikkhū pucchiṃsu api ~e evarūpaṃ dārakaṃ passeyyāthā ti); III 7, 6 (āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etad avoca etarahi ~e Verañjā dubbhikkhā); 10, 30 (evaṃ ~e ti kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paccassosi); 23, 10 (te … evaṃ vadenti na mayaṃ ~e Ānanda buddhagarahino); 102, 2 (devatā taṃ bhikkhuṃ apasādesi mā ~e evarūpaṃ abhaṇi); IV 287, 26 (suṇātu me ~e saṅgho); D I 51, 3 (rājā Māgadho Ajātasattu Vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca puccheyyām’ ahaṃ ~e bhagavantaṃ kañci-d-eva desaṃ); 179, 16 (Poṭṭhapādo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etad avoca etu kho ~e bhagavā sāgataṃ ~e bhagavato); II 154, 14 (theratarena … bhikkhunā navakataro bhikkhu nāmena vā gottena vā āvusovādena vā samudācaritabbo, navakatarena bhikkhunā therataro bhikkhu ~e ti vā āyasmā ti vā samudācaritabbo); S V 162, 7 (evaṃ ~e ti kho Cundo samaṇuddeso āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosi); Nidd I 229, 22 (ekacco antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho na pavisa ~e ti vuccamāno pavisati); Mil 8, 9 (tena h’ āvuso Rohaṇa daṇḍakammaṃ karohī ti, kiṃ ~e karomī ti); 25, 7 (Milindo rājā āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ etad avoca kathaṃ bhadanto ñāyati kinnāmo si ~e ti); 27, 3 (akkho ratho ti na hi ~e ti); Vism 635, 6 (kiṃ āvuso Dhammadinna akāle āgato sī ti ca vutte pañhaṃ ~e pucchituṃ āgato ’smī ti āha); Mhv 14:20 (santi te ñātakā rāja santi ~e bahū janā); — bhante na in Ee at S V 369, 13 foll.: read bhantena with Be, Ce, Se; — see also bhadanta, bhava(t).

bhantacitta.p: [Bhanta+citta] (ti) CL=8 swaying; revolved; whirled about the mind; A person who has a trembling mind.
